meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 多了一个“更新技能”的本事:它会把你已装的技能(如 Slack、Discord 等)的代码换成最新版,只覆盖这些技能自己的文件,不动你的配置、密码或数据。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 里运行 `/update-skills` 命令时触发。前提是工作树干净,`origin` 指向 NanoClaw 上游仓库。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills 更新已安装的技能。
say.note: 先检查工作树,再让你勾选要更新的技能。

say.text: 只更新 Slack 和 Discord 技能。
say.note: 会逐个重新应用,只刷新这两个技能的文件。

say.text: 跳过,现在不更新任何技能。
say.note: 不重新应用任何技能,直接结束。

howto.what_en: Re-applies installed skills (e.g. Slack, Discord) by fetching their latest code from upstream and overwriting copied files. Leaves local config, credentials, and DB state untouched; never merges a branch.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run `/update-skills` in Claude Code. Requires a clean working tree and an `origin` remote pointing at the NanoClaw upstream repo.

say_en.note: Checks the working tree, then asks which to update.

say_en.text: Only update the Slack and Discord skills.
say_en.note: Re-applies each, refreshing only those files.

say_en.text: Skip, don't update any skills now.
